main: Steady State Core Gradient Beacon Consumption DMG

a1Beacons.label: Gradient Beacons for the party
a1Beacons.reason: Elemental Mastery per Gradient Beacon, which build up during the fight.

a4Stacks.label: CRIT Rate per Gradient Beacon made
a4Stacks.reason: Re-decided as Neuvillette's A1 was: her own Detection Core makes the Gradient Beacons, each stack lasts 15 seconds (longer than a beacon's 10), and her main hits consume those beacons, so they land at the most stacks once the core has made four.

c2CoreType.label: Constellation 2 core bonus
c2CoreType.reason: A Constellation 2 buff that depends on the core's state.
